Projects

Three projects so far, including the site you're looking at — and one honest failure.

📚 szlib

A few Python scripts that keep track of the books I've borrowed from Shenzhen Library — due dates, overdue alerts, history snapshots, and a small dashboard that shows everything at a glance.

Stack: Python · GitHub (private)

🌻 PvZ-sync

An attempt to back up a Plants vs. Zombies 2 save with git + adb so it could survive a device change. The restore works — but only offline. EA keys online progress to a per-install GUID that lives outside the save files, so a second device gets reset to zero on its first online boot. Did not work, honestly documented.

Stack: adb + git · GitHub (private)

🖥 cerfly.net

This website. Built from scratch with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no frameworks. Hand-crafted with opencode, custom dark/light theme, deployed free on Cloudflare Pages with git-driven deploys.

Stack: HTML + CSS + JS · Cloudflare Pages

More projects coming as I learn and build. The plain HTML pages above are my first commit to that journey.
